# Zarafé Hospitality
> Catering for medical events in Hyderabad, India: CME programmes, medical conferences, pharma and device company meetings, health expos and hospital functions. Proprietor: Aneeqa Sultana.

- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 88010 91203
- Email: hello@zarafehospitality.com
- Track record: official caterer of the Caspian Diabesity Expo 2024 and 2025 (about 1,000 plates per sitting in 2025); CME programmes across Hyderabad
- Every menu includes a marked diabetic-friendly plate; vegetarian, Jain, eggless, low-sodium options on request; halal chicken and mutton
- Quote within 24 hours; free tasting for confirmed events of 200+ guests; final headcount 48 hours before the event
